label: Pre-encounter — a blade in the nursery
location: The Verdant Ward, the nursery rows

recentEvents.value: The rookeries have gone silent; fledglings and seedlings are being moved deeper into the Ward.
A walker with a drawn blade is straying off the swept path, toward the nests.

unresolvedConflicts.value: An armed stranger who understands every word and keeps trampling toward the nesting rows.

temporaryObjective.value: Guide the walker back onto the swept path and out of the nursery.
